title: Defensive programming: eliminate unwrap anti-patterns
description:
Replace defensive programming anti-patterns across the codebase.

1. visibility.rs:47 — unwrap on player lookup (should use let-else/continue)
2. runtime.rs:113 — unwrap on last_mut after push (should use expect with message)
3. transition.rs — zone default to "board" without validation
4. perturber fuel cap silently truncates without error — should warn or error

Fix: Replace all unwrap() with expect() or pattern matching. Add error/warning when fuel is silently capped. Document implicit zone name coupling.
close_reason: Replaced unwrap with let-else in visibility.rs, expect with message in runtime.rs.
